Notice is hereby given that a 2024 proposed budget has been submitted to the Clay County Commission and a public hearing will be held. Read on...

Public Notification: Senior Real Estate Property Tax Relief (SB190) Update
The tax bills for the parcels enrolled in the Senior Real Estate Property Tax Relief program are available online. Payments for these parcels may be made by check, cashier’s check, or money order. Read on...
Clay County Employees Receive Lifesaving Safety Training
Clay County Parks and Road & Bridge employees participated in lifesaving training in partnership with NKC Health and the Clay County Sheriff’s Office. Read on...
Heather Shull Named First Recipient of Clay County Safety Star Award
Clay County has named Heather Shull the first recipient of its new Safety Star Award, recognizing employees who identify potential hazards, take action and help create a safer workplace and community. Read on...
Aubrey and Recorder of Deeds Team Earn Praise for Exceptional Service
A recent letter to Clay County officials recognized Aubrey and her colleagues in the Recorder of Deeds office for their patience, professionalism and commitment to helping the public. Read on...
Honoring Eric Zahnd: Clay County Remembers Longtime Platte County Prosecutor
The Northland community is mourning the loss of Platte County Prosecuting Attorney Eric Zahnd, who passed away after nearly 24 years of dedicated public service. Read on...
Clay County Honors Judge Shane T. Alexander for Service and Community Impact
The Clay County Commission recognized the Honorable Judge Shane T. Alexander with an honorary resolution celebrating his dedication to public service and his meaningful contributions to the community. Read on...

Clay County staff gathered for a farewell celebration honoring County Collector Barbara O’Riley and her 19 years of service to the county. Read on...

GFOA’s Triple Crown designation recognizes governments who have received GFOA’s Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting, Popular Annual Financial Reporting Award, and Distinguished Budget Presentation Award for a fiscal year. Read on...
Sarah Rose Receives 2026 Outstanding Leader Award from Missouri Mappers Association
Clay County is proud to announce that Sarah Rose has received the 2026 Outstanding Leader Award from the Missouri Mappers Association. Read on...
Clay County, Missouri Sheriff's Office Saves Life 48 Hours After Deploying Avive AEDs
First county in Missouri to equip its Sheriff's Office with Avive Connect AED® units credits fast deployment, real-time guidance, and instant data transfer with a full cardiac arrest recovery. Read on...
Clay County Historic Sites Awarded Freedom’s Frontier National Heritage Area Grant
Clay County Historic Sites has been awarded a grant from Freedom’s Frontier
National Heritage Area (FFNHA) to support the Slave Dwelling Project. Read on...
Clay County Earns GFOA Award for Outstanding Achievement in Popular Annual Financial Reporting
Clay County has received the Government Finance Officers Association’s (GFOA) Award for Outstanding Achievement in Popular Annual Financial Reporting (PAFR Award) for its 2024 Popular Annual Financial Report. Read on...
Stockdale Road Bridge Replacement (Update 05/21)
The Clay County Road & Bridge Department is preparing to replace the Stockdale Road Bridge. Read on...
Clay County Earns National Recognition for Excellence in Financial Reporting
Clay County has received the Government Finance Officers Association’s (GFOA) prestigious Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting for its Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2024. Read on...
The Clay County Civic Academy Applications Are Open Now!
Have you ever wanted to learn more about your County or become a more active resident? Now's your chance! Read on...
Senior Tax Relief Program Update 02/18/2026
Receipts are now being generated in the standard format and will be accessible to each taxpayer on the online portal as accounts are finalized. Read on...
Public Statement Concerning the Royals Negotiations with Clay County
For nearly three years, the Clay County Commission has engaged in discussions with the ownership of the Kansas City Royals regarding the potential relocation of the team to Clay County. Read on...

The Clay County Commission has approved an update to the County’s Senior Real Estate Property Tax Relief Program on January 8th, 2026. Read on...
Senior Real Estate Property Tax Relief: 2026 Applications Now Open
The 2026 application and renewal period for the Senior Real Estate Property Tax Relief Program is now open from January 1st, 2026 to March 31st, 2026. This program helps eligible seniors manage rising property tax costs. Read on...
Public Notification: Clay County Tax Deadline Extension
Due to the delays brought on by the Senior Real Estate Property Tax Relief Program (SB190), many residents received their tax bills later than anticipated. Read on...
Clay County Parks, Recreation and Historic Sites (Park Department) is developing a Master Plan
This master plan will create clear and realistic goals, objectives, forecasted needs and implementation strategies to provide direction for the agency. Read on...
Important Update: 2025 Tax Bills Posted for Most Clay County Residents
We would like to thank all of our Clay County residents inquiring about the 2025 tax bills. In past years, the Collector’s Office has been able to post tax bills online in early November. Read on...
Law Enforcement Resource Center Opens Its Doors
We’re excited to announce the official opening of the Law Enforcement Resource Center for our Sheriff’s Office??. This new center will help ensure our county sheriff staff—and partnering local agencies—stay trained, prepared, and ready to serve... Read on...

Clay County is proud to announce the completion of two major infrastructure projects on Nation Road: a streambank stabilization and roadway realignment, along with the construction of a brand-new bridge over Rock Creek. Read on...
Clay County to Celebrate Re-Opening of the Kansas City Trapshooters Association (KCTA) Clubhouse
Clay County is proud to announce the grand re-opening of the Kansas City Trapshooters Association (KCTA) clubhouse. Read on...

2025. Read on...

The U.S. Bicycle Route System (USBRS) is adding four new routes in three states, including Missouri and Clay County. This is following an approved proposal brought forth to the commission back in January 2024. Read on...
